title: About This Project
text: This website provides an interactive dashboard for analyzing historical stock price data from major NASDAQ-listed technology companies.

title: About This Project
text: This website provides an interactive dashboard for analyzing historical stock price data from major NASDAQ-listed technology companies.

title: About This Project
text:
Technical Stack

Data Collection: Python with requests and pandas libraries
Data Source: NASDAQ API (https://api.nasdaq.com/)
Frontend: HTML5, JavaScript, Plotly.js for interactive charting
Data Format: CSV files with OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) data
Visualization: Quarto website with embedded interactive charts

title: About This Project
text:
Data Details

Date Range: Approximately 2 years of historical data (2024-2026)
Trading Days: ~499 trading days per stock
Update Frequency: Data extracted as of June 2026
Stocks Covered: 10 major tech companies (AAPL, GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN, TSLA, NVDA, META, NFLX, ADBE, INTC)

title: About This Project
text:
Chart Features

Chart Types

Candlestick: Shows open, high, low, close with traditional candlestick format
OHLC: Traditional open-high-low-close bar chart
Line: Simple line chart showing closing prices



Time Periods

1M: Last 1 month
3M: Last 3 months
6M: Last 6 months
1Y: Last 1 year
All: Complete dataset



Statistics

Current Price & Change
Opening Price
52-Week High/Low
Average Volume
Dynamic filtering based on selected time period

title: About This Project
text:
Repository
All code is available on GitHub. The Python scraper can be used to fetch updated stock data, and the visualization can be deployed anywhere that serves static HTML/CSS/JavaScript files.

title: NASDAQ Stock Charts
text:
This project provides an interactive charting dashboard for analyzing historical stock price data from 10 major NASDAQ companies.



AAPL - Apple Inc.
GOOGL - Alphabet Inc.
MSFT - Microsoft Corporation
AMZN - Amazon.com Inc.
TSLA - Tesla Inc.
NVDA - NVIDIA Corporation
META - Meta Platforms Inc.
NFLX - Netflix Inc.
ADBE - Adobe Inc.
INTC - Intel Corporation





📊 Interactive Charts - Candlestick, OHLC, and Line chart types
📅 Time Filtering - View 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, or all-time data
📈 Real-time Statistics - Open, High, Low, Volume, and 52-week metrics
🔄 Dynamic Stock Selection - Switch between stocks seamlessly




All historical data is sourced directly from NASDAQ.com, covering approximately 2 years of trading data (~499 trading days per stock).
